svg.title: Sharp projective mass ratio and certified full-integral envelope
svg.desc: Left: the convex scalar density as a function of projective ratio b, enclosed by its chord and tangent at rho 9 over 8. Right: exact lower and upper bounds for the normalized finite mass response for rho between seven eighths and nine eighths. The shaded region contains the full normalized integral response.
svg.text: THE FIRST MASS JET / A FINITE ENVELOPE
A continuum enclosed by two equal-mass observables
Projective positivity makes the endpoint bounds exact, not statistical.
